author: researcher
claim: Cronometer lets the user choose whether nutrition trend averages include all days or exclude days with no data, according to 2018 and 2019 forum posts including one by Cronometer staff.
subject: Cronometer
limitations: Forum posts from 2018 (a user) and 2019 (a staff member), not current help documentation and not observed in the app; the current app may differ. The default option is not stated. Not specific to weekly averages.
